prompt: Camera holds still. From the first second, more and more of the seated people behind the front row raise their round "£50" paddles, one after another, until the hall is full of them; each paddle reads "£50" clearly. In the front row the heavy bald man in the pinstripe suit twists round in his chair to look back at them, face reddening, mouth set in outrage, then turns his head back towards the lectern. The thin clerk beside him sinks a little lower, holding his paddle in his lap. The masked auctioneer at the right edge stands still with gavel raised, his navy balaclava with white ring and red triangle unchanged. Nobody speaks. Sound: rustle of paddles going up, a rising murmur, light rain on the marquee. Real, soft tent daylight.
